role: Primary research qualifications, not independent second review
native_preservation_scope: The automatic comparisons establish original artist geometry, original face colors, original point offsets/faces, text and view equality. They do not claim pixel equality between annotated and original images. Colored strokes necessarily change boundary pixels.
dot_overdraw: Plane475 auxiliary segments and Plane479 overlays meet actual original black dots. Thin colored strokes can overpaint small portions of dot raster disks. All original dot artists, their exact coordinates and count remain, their black cores are visibly identifiable, and no new marked dot or selectable vertex is introduced. Literal dot-raster pixel identity is not claimed.
antialiasing: The earlier marker_visibility_audit.json exact-RGB test yielded false absence flags for several thin antialiased strokes. That diagnostic remains unchanged. marker_chroma_audit.json uses actual palette hue in the native PNG at each segment center and confirms every mark visible. This clarification does not change any image, plugin, preset, raw request or response.
old_Plane472: Old run01 has 97,567 content characters and stop finish; it is a real completed call even though much of its narrative loops and the terminal text contains a stray System Instruction fragment. Old run02 has 7,140 characters. Both full contents were read in bounded chunks, and neither is a hit on old presetC.
Plane479_parent_hypothesis: The three original square interiors do not overlap. Replacing sum by union gives the same area12 and is not a wrong-answer mechanism. The new frozen hypothesis is specifically omission of middle gray triangleACK after a true auxiliary decomposition.
physical_ink_lesson: Plane242 exact colored-paper transport has been read in full and is not repaired or promoted. These six designs ask fixed numerical area/count/congruence questions; each original face/point/label identity is separately preserved. No blanket permission or prohibition follows from a schema or from the Plane242 verdict.
causal_limit: A final answer matching a preset does not establish the intended geometric mechanism. No statistical gain, causal effect or identical narrative is asserted; no control-correctness hard gate is added.
old_and_new_evidence: No old failed, aborted, rejected or independently held image was retested. The only local renderer failure had no PNG and no API; its plugin/context/audit remain. A separate exact-edge Plane473 variant has a different source corner and removes a duplicate action before its own frozen two calls.
